title: Parallel sprint workers run a changed-paths test selection, and the whole suite runs once at the landing or review, so four workers do not push each other over the seconds ceiling
goal: A worker's brief has it run python3 _tools/tests.py --changed origin/main (or its item's selection) instead of the whole suite, leaving the whole-suite run to the landing's done and the review; found in SP-7ff7c5ui: every worker's whole-suite run (five workers, 25 to 32 s, all 100 tests passing) was refused at the 24 s darwin ceiling while siblings ran, and each worker reran it to no effect
